#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# secret-rotation-validator.sh
#
# Validate a configuration of secrets against their rotation policies and
# report which ones are expired, expiring soon (within a warning window), or
# still healthy. Supports markdown-table and JSON output formats.
#
# The script is designed to be both executable (CLI) and source-able (so the
# bats unit tests can call its pure functions directly). The CLI entrypoint is
# guarded by a sourced-vs-executed check at the bottom of the file.

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# days_between <earlier-date> <later-date>
#
# Echo the whole number of days between two YYYY-MM-DD dates (later - earlier).
# Uses GNU date to convert to epoch seconds, which sidesteps month-length and
# leap-year arithmetic. A negative result is possible if the order is reversed.
days_between() {
  local earlier="$1" later="$2"
  local e_epoch l_epoch
  e_epoch=$(date -u -d "$earlier" +%s) || return 1
  l_epoch=$(date -u -d "$later" +%s) || return 1
  echo $(( (l_epoch - e_epoch) / 86400 ))
}

# classify_secret <last_rotated> <policy_days> <warning_days> <now>
#
# Classify a single secret into one of three urgency buckets:
#   expired  - age >= policy_days (rotation overdue)

# Approach
# --------

# source it to call the pure functions (days_between, classify_secret)
# directly; the CLI entrypoint at the bottom is guarded by a
# sourced-vs-executed check so sourcing never triggers main().

#   name                 - string identifier of the secret
#   last_rotated         - YYYY-MM-DD date the secret was last rotated
#   rotation_policy_days - integer: rotate at least every N days
#   required_by          - array of service names that depend on the secret

#   warning  - age >= policy - warning_days        (due within the window)
#   ok       - otherwise

# Pure helper functions (unit-tested directly)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# days_between <earlier-date> <later-date>

# Echo the whole number of days between two YYYY-MM-DD dates (later - earlier).
# Uses GNU date -> epoch seconds, which sidesteps month-length and leap-year
# arithmetic. A negative result is possible if the dates are reversed.
days_between() {
  local earlier="$1" later="$2"
  local e_epoch l_epoch

  l_epoch=$(date -u -d "$later" +%s) || return 1

#
# Classify a single secret into one of three urgency buckets:
# expired | warning | ok. See the file header for the exact thresholds.

  local last_rotated="$1" policy_days="$2" warning_days="$3" now="$4"
  local age
  age=$(days_between "$last_rotated" "$now") || return 1

  if (( age >= policy_days )); then
    echo "expired"
  elif (( age >= policy_days - warning_days )); then
    echo "warning"
  else
    echo "ok"
  fi
}

# Config validation and error handling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# die <message> [exit-code]

die() {

  -h, --help             Show this help and exit.
EOF

  local config="" warning_days=14 format="markdown" now=""

  while (( $# > 0 )); do
    case "$1" in
      --config)       config="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --warning-days) warning_days="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --format)       format="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --now)          now="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      -h|--help)      usage; return 0 ;;
      *) die "unknown argument: $1" 2 ;;
    esac
  done

  # Validate inputs with meaningful messages.
  validate_config "$config"
  [[ "$warning_days" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "--warning-days must be a non-negative integer: $warning_days" 2
  [[ -z "$now" ]] && now="$(date -u +%F)"
  date -u -d "$now" +%s >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "invalid --now date: $now" 2

  local report
  report=$(build_report "$config" "$warning_days" "$now")

  case "$format" in
    markdown) printf '%s\n' "$report" | format_markdown ;;
    json)     printf '%s\n' "$report" | format_json ;;
    *) die "unknown format: $format (expected markdown or json)" 2 ;;
  esac
}

#   warning  - age >= policy - warning_days        (due within the window)
#   ok       - otherwise
#
# The reference "now" is configurable via --now (default: system date) so the
# behaviour is deterministic and testable.

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure helper functions (unit-tested directly)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# days_between <earlier-date> <later-date>
#
# Echo the whole number of days between two YYYY-MM-DD dates (later - earlier).
# Uses GNU date -> epoch seconds, which sidesteps month-length and leap-year
# arithmetic. A negative result is possible if the dates are reversed.
days_between() {
  local earlier="$1" later="$2"
  local e_epoch l_epoch
  e_epoch=$(date -u -d "$earlier" +%s) || return 1
  l_epoch=$(date -u -d "$later" +%s) || return 1
  echo $(( (l_epoch - e_epoch) / 86400 ))
}

# classify_secret <last_rotated> <policy_days> <warning_days> <now>
#
# Classify a single secret into one of three urgency buckets:
# expired | warning | ok. See the file header for the exact thresholds.
classify_secret() {
  local last_rotated="$1" policy_days="$2" warning_days="$3" now="$4"
  local age
  age=$(days_between "$last_rotated" "$now") || return 1

  if (( age >= policy_days )); then
    echo "expired"
  elif (( age >= policy_days - warning_days )); then
    echo "warning"
  else
    echo "ok"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config validation and error handling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# die <message> [exit-code]
# Print an error to stderr and exit. Default exit code is 1.
die() {
  local msg="$1" code="${2:-1}"
  echo "error: $msg" >&2
  exit "$code"
}

# validate_config <path>
#
# Ensure the config file exists, is readable, contains valid JSON, and is a
# JSON array. Echoes nothing on success; dies with a meaningful message on
# failure.
validate_config() {
  local path="$1"
  [[ -n "$path" ]]    || die "no --config file provided" 2
  [[ -e "$path" ]]    || die "config file not found: $path" 2
  [[ -r "$path" ]]    || die "config file not readable: $path" 2
  jq empty "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "config file is not valid JSON: $path" 2
  local kind
  kind=$(jq -r 'type' "$path")
  [[ "$kind" == "array" ]] || die "config root must be a JSON array, got: $kind" 2
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report building
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# build_report <config> <warning_days> <now>
#
# Read the validated config and emit a single enriched JSON document on stdout:
#   { generated_for, warning_days, summary:{expired,warning,ok}, secrets:[...] }
# Each secret gains age_days, days_until_due (negative => overdue) and status.
# Classification is computed in jq to keep the whole report a single pass; the
# logic mirrors classify_secret exactly (and both are covered by tests).
build_report() {
  local config="$1" warning_days="$2" now="$3"
  local now_epoch
  now_epoch=$(date -u -d "$now" +%s) || die "invalid --now date: $now" 2

  jq \
    --argjson now "$now_epoch" \
    --argjson warn "$warning_days" \
    --arg now_str "$now" '
    # age in whole days between last_rotated and "now"
    def age(lr): (($now - (lr | strptime("%Y-%m-%d") | mktime)) / 86400) | floor;

    [ .[]
      | . as $s
      | age(.last_rotated) as $age
      | ($s.rotation_policy_days - $age) as $until
      | {
          name: $s.name,
          last_rotated: $s.last_rotated,
          rotation_policy_days: $s.rotation_policy_days,
          required_by: ($s.required_by // []),
          age_days: $age,
          days_until_due: $until,
          status: (
            if $age >= $s.rotation_policy_days then "expired"
            elif $age >= ($s.rotation_policy_days - $warn) then "warning"
            else "ok" end
          )
        }
    ] as $secrets
    | {
        generated_for: $now_str,
        warning_days: $warn,
        summary: {
          expired: ([ $secrets[] | select(.status == "expired") ] | length),
          warning: ([ $secrets[] | select(.status == "warning") ] | length),
          ok:      ([ $secrets[] | select(.status == "ok") ] | length)
        },
        secrets: $secrets
      }
  ' "$config"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output formatters (consume the report JSON on stdin)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# format_markdown  - render the report JSON as grouped markdown tables.
format_markdown() {
  jq -r '
    def row:
      "| \(.name) | \(.last_rotated) | \(.rotation_policy_days) | "
      + "\(.days_until_due) | \(.required_by | join(", ")) |";

    def section(title; key):
      ( [ .secrets[] | select(.status == key) ] ) as $rows
      | "## \(title) (\($rows | length))",
        "",
        ( if ($rows | length) == 0 then
            "_None._"
          else
            ( "| Secret | Last Rotated | Policy (days) | Days Until Due | Required By |",
              "|--------|--------------|---------------|----------------|-------------|",
              ( $rows[] | row ) )
          end ),
        "";

    "# Secret Rotation Report",
    "",
    "Generated for: \(.generated_for) (warning window: \(.warning_days) days)",
    "",
    "Summary: \(.summary.expired) expired, \(.summary.warning) warning, \(.summary.ok) ok",
    "",
    ( section("Expired"; "expired") ),
    ( section("Warning"; "warning") ),
    ( section("OK"; "ok") )
  '
}

# format_json  - pretty-print the report JSON unchanged.
format_json() {
  jq '.'
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI entrypoint
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: secret-rotation-validator.sh --config <file> [options]

Options:
  --config <file>        Path to the secrets JSON config (required).
  --warning-days <N>     Warning window in days (default: 14).
  --format <fmt>         Output format: markdown | json (default: markdown).
  --now <YYYY-MM-DD>     Reference "today" date (default: system date).
  -h, --help             Show this help and exit.
EOF
}

main() {
  local config="" warning_days=14 format="markdown" now=""

  while (( $# > 0 )); do
    case "$1" in
      --config)       config="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --warning-days) warning_days="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --format)       format="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --now)          now="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      -h|--help)      usage; return 0 ;;
      *) die "unknown argument: $1" 2 ;;
    esac
  done

  # Validate inputs with meaningful messages.
  validate_config "$config"
  [[ "$warning_days" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "--warning-days must be a non-negative integer: $warning_days" 2
  [[ -z "$now" ]] && now="$(date -u +%F)"
  date -u -d "$now" +%s >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "invalid --now date: $now" 2

  local report
  report=$(build_report "$config" "$warning_days" "$now")

  case "$format" in
    markdown) printf '%s\n' "$report" | format_markdown ;;
    json)     printf '%s\n' "$report" | format_json ;;
    *) die "unknown format: $format (expected markdown or json)" 2 ;;
  esac
}

# Only run main when executed directly, not when sourced by the test suite.
if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
  main "$@"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# secret-rotation-validator.sh
#
# Reads a JSON configuration of secrets (name, last_rotated date,
# rotation_policy_days, required_by services) and classifies each secret by
# rotation urgency:
#   - expired : the rotation deadline is already in the past
#   - warning : the rotation deadline falls within the warning window
#   - ok      : the rotation deadline is comfortably in the future
#
# It then emits a rotation report grouped by urgency, in either a markdown
# table or JSON.
#
# Usage:
#   secret-rotation-validator.sh --config FILE [--today YYYY-MM-DD]
#                                [--warning-days N] [--format markdown|json]
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  success
#   2  usage / configuration error
#
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  cat >&2 <<'USAGE'
Usage: secret-rotation-validator.sh --config FILE [options]

Options:
  --config FILE        Path to the secrets JSON config (required).
  --today YYYY-MM-DD   Reference date for the calculation (default: today, UTC).
  --warning-days N     Warning window in days (default: 14).
  --format FORMAT      Output format: markdown (default) or json.
  -h, --help           Show this help.
USAGE
}

# die MESSAGE: print an error to stderr and exit with a usage error code.
die() {
  echo "error: $*" >&2
  return 2
}

# build_model CONFIG TODAY_EPOCH WARNING_DAYS
# Emits the enriched JSON "model": every secret annotated with
# days_until_expiry and status, plus a summary grouped by urgency. This single
# model is the source of truth that every output format renders from.
build_model() {
  local config="$1" today_epoch="$2" warning_days="$3"
  jq --argjson today "$today_epoch" --argjson warn "$warning_days" '
    # Days from "today" until the rotation deadline. Dates are parsed as UTC so
    # they line up with the UTC epoch passed in for "today".
    def daysuntil(lr; pol):
      ((lr | strptime("%Y-%m-%d") | mktime) + (pol * 86400) - $today) / 86400
      | floor;
    [
      .[]
      | (daysuntil(.last_rotated; .rotation_policy_days)) as $du
      | {
          name,
          last_rotated,
          rotation_policy_days,
          required_by,
          days_until_expiry: $du,
          status: (if   $du < 0      then "expired"
                   elif $du <= $warn then "warning"
                   else                   "ok"      end)
        }
    ] as $secrets
    | {
        secrets: $secrets,
        summary: {
          expired: ([ $secrets[] | select(.status == "expired") ] | length),
          warning: ([ $secrets[] | select(.status == "warning") ] | length),
          ok:      ([ $secrets[] | select(.status == "ok")      ] | length),
          total:   ($secrets | length)
        }
      }
  ' "$config"
}

# render_markdown MODEL_JSON
# Renders the model as a grouped markdown report.
render_markdown() {
  jq -r '
    def section(title; key):
      "## " + title + " (" + (.summary[key] | tostring) + ")",
      "",
      "| Secret | Last Rotated | Policy (days) | Days Until Expiry | Required By |",
      "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
      ( [ .secrets[] | select(.status == key) ] as $rows
        | if ($rows | length) == 0
          then "| _none_ |  |  |  |  |"
          else ( $rows[]
                 | "| " + .name
                   + " | " + .last_rotated
                   + " | " + (.rotation_policy_days | tostring)
                   + " | " + (.days_until_expiry | tostring)
                   + " | " + (.required_by | join(", "))
                   + " |" )
          end ),
      "";
    "# Secret Rotation Report",
    "",
    "Total secrets: \(.summary.total) | "
      + "Expired: \(.summary.expired) | "
      + "Warning: \(.summary.warning) | "
      + "OK: \(.summary.ok)",
    "",
    section("Expired"; "expired"),
    section("Warning"; "warning"),
    section("OK"; "ok")
  '
}

main() {
  local config="" today="" warning_days=14 format="markdown"

  while (( $# > 0 )); do
    case "$1" in
      --config)       config="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --today)        today="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --warning-days) warning_days="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      --format)       format="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
      -h|--help)      usage; return 0 ;;
      *)              die "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  # --- validate inputs -----------------------------------------------------
  [[ -n "$config" ]] || { die "missing required --config FILE"; }
  [[ -f "$config" ]] || { die "config file not found: $config"; }
  jq empty "$config" 2>/dev/null || { die "config is not valid JSON: $config"; }

  [[ "$warning_days" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] \
    || { die "--warning-days must be a non-negative integer, got: $warning_days"; }

  case "$format" in
    markdown|json) ;;
    *) die "--format must be 'markdown' or 'json', got: $format" ;;
  esac

  # Default "today" to the current UTC date if not supplied (testability hook).
  [[ -n "$today" ]] || today="$(date -u +%F)"

  local today_epoch
  # Parse as UTC midnight so the math matches jq's UTC date handling.
  today_epoch="$(date -u -d "$today" +%s 2>/dev/null)" \
    || { die "invalid --today date: $today"; }

  local model
  model="$(build_model "$config" "$today_epoch" "$warning_days")"

  if [[ "$format" == "json" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$model"
  else
    printf '%s' "$model" | render_markdown
  fi
}

# Triggers:
#   - push / pull_request: validate on every change to the repo
#   - schedule: a daily cron so rotation drift is caught even without commits
#   - workflow_dispatch: allow manual runs (with overridable inputs)
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      warning_days:
        description: "Warning window in days"
        required: false
        default: "14"
      now:
        description: "Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD); blank = today"
        required: false
        default: "2024-02-10"

# Principle of least privilege: the validator only reads repo contents.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Deterministic defaults so the report output is reproducible in CI and under
# `act`. workflow_dispatch inputs override NOW/WARNING_DAYS when provided.
env:
  CONFIG_FILE: fixtures/secrets.json
  NOW: ${{ github.event.inputs.now || '2024-02-10' }}
  WARNING_DAYS: ${{ github.event.inputs.warning_days || '14' }}

jobs:
  # Job 1: run the bats unit/integration suite for the script itself.
  test:
    name: Unit tests (bats)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (jq, bats)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq bats shellcheck

      - name: Syntax + lint checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash -n secret-rotation-validator.sh
          shellcheck secret-rotation-validator.sh

      - name: Run bats tests
        run: bats tests/

  # Job 2: generate the rotation report and assert on its contents. Depends on
  # the test job so reports are only produced once the script is known good.
  report:
    name: Generate rotation report
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (jq)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq

      - name: Generate JSON report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./secret-rotation-validator.sh \
            --config "$CONFIG_FILE" \
            --warning-days "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format json | tee report.json

      - name: Generate Markdown report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./secret-rotation-validator.sh \
            --config "$CONFIG_FILE" \
            --warning-days "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format markdown | tee report.md

      - name: Emit machine-readable summary
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expired=$(jq -r '.summary.expired' report.json)
          warning=$(jq -r '.summary.warning' report.json)
          ok=$(jq -r '.summary.ok' report.json)
          # A single stable marker line the act test harness asserts on.
          echo "ROTATION_SUMMARY expired=${expired} warning=${warning} ok=${ok}"

      - name: Fail the build if any secret is expired
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expired=$(jq -r '.summary.expired' report.json)
          if [ "$expired" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::${expired} secret(s) past their rotation deadline"
            # Surface expired secret names for operators.
            jq -r '.secrets[] | select(.status=="expired") | "  - \(.name)"' report.json
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "No expired secrets."

  CONFIG_FILE: fixtures/secrets.json
  NOW: ${{ github.event.inputs.now || '2024-02-10' }}
  WARNING_DAYS: ${{ github.event.inputs.warning_days || '14' }}

  # Job 1: run the bats unit/integration suite for the script itself.

    name: Unit tests (bats)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (jq, bats, shellcheck)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq bats shellcheck

      - name: Syntax + lint checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash -n secret-rotation-validator.sh
          shellcheck secret-rotation-validator.sh

      - name: Run bats tests
        run: bats tests/

  # Job 2: generate the rotation report and assert on its contents. Depends on
  # the test job so reports are only produced once the script is known good.
  report:
    name: Generate rotation report
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (jq)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq

      - name: Generate JSON report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./secret-rotation-validator.sh \
            --config "$CONFIG_FILE" \
            --warning-days "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format json | tee report.json

      - name: Generate Markdown report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./secret-rotation-validator.sh \
            --config "$CONFIG_FILE" \
            --warning-days "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format markdown | tee report.md

      - name: Emit machine-readable summary
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expired=$(jq -r '.summary.expired' report.json)
          warning=$(jq -r '.summary.warning' report.json)
          ok=$(jq -r '.summary.ok' report.json)
          # A single stable marker line the act test harness asserts on.
          echo "ROTATION_SUMMARY expired=${expired} warning=${warning} ok=${ok}"

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expired=$(jq -r '.summary.expired' report.json)
          if [ "$expired" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::${expired} secret(s) past their rotation deadline"
            jq -r '.secrets[] | select(.status=="expired") | "  - \(.name)"' report.json
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "No expired secrets."

name: Secret Rotation Validator

# Triggers:
#   - push / pull_request: validate on every change to the repo
#   - schedule: a daily cron so rotation drift is caught even without commits
#   - workflow_dispatch: allow manual runs (with overridable inputs)
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      warning_days:
        description: "Warning window in days"
        required: false
        default: "14"
      now:
        description: "Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD); blank = today"
        required: false
        default: "2024-02-10"

# Principle of least privilege: the validator only reads repo contents.
permissions:
  contents: read

# Deterministic defaults so the report output is reproducible in CI and under
# `act`. workflow_dispatch inputs override NOW/WARNING_DAYS when provided.
env:
  CONFIG_FILE: config/secrets.json
  NOW: ${{ github.event.inputs.now || '2024-02-10' }}
  WARNING_DAYS: ${{ github.event.inputs.warning_days || '14' }}
  # Report-only by default; set to "true" to make expired secrets fail the build.
  FAIL_ON_EXPIRED: "false"

jobs:
  # Job 1: run the bats unit/integration suite for the script itself.
  test:
    name: Unit tests (bats)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (jq, bats, shellcheck)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq bats shellcheck

      - name: Syntax + lint checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash -n secret-rotation-validator.sh
          shellcheck secret-rotation-validator.sh

      - name: Run bats tests
        run: bats tests/

  # Job 2: generate the rotation report and assert on its contents. Depends on
  # the test job so reports are only produced once the script is known good.
  report:
    name: Generate rotation report
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (jq)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq jq

      - name: Generate JSON report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./secret-rotation-validator.sh \
            --config "$CONFIG_FILE" \
            --warning-days "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format json | tee report.json

      - name: Generate Markdown report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./secret-rotation-validator.sh \
            --config "$CONFIG_FILE" \
            --warning-days "$WARNING_DAYS" \
            --now "$NOW" \
            --format markdown | tee report.md

      - name: Emit machine-readable summary
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expired=$(jq -r '.summary.expired' report.json)
          warning=$(jq -r '.summary.warning' report.json)
          ok=$(jq -r '.summary.ok' report.json)
          # A single stable marker line the act test harness asserts on.
          echo "ROTATION_SUMMARY expired=${expired} warning=${warning} ok=${ok}"

      - name: Report (and optionally fail on) expired secrets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expired=$(jq -r '.summary.expired' report.json)
          if [ "$expired" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::warning::${expired} secret(s) past their rotation deadline"
            jq -r '.secrets[] | select(.status=="expired") | "  - \(.name)"' report.json
            if [ "$FAIL_ON_EXPIRED" = "true" ]; then
              echo "::error::FAIL_ON_EXPIRED is set; failing the build"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "No expired secrets."
          fi

  "all-ok|tests/cases/all-ok.json|0 0 2"

)

  cp "$ROOT/fixtures/secrets.json" "$work/fixtures/"
